After changing the stock status, I should save the changes by clicking the 'Save' button. The tree shows a 'Save' button in the main area. I will click it and wait for the page to update. python_code:
async def act(page):
    # Change the stock status to 'Out of Stock' by selecting the option in the combobox
    stock_combobox = page.get_by_role('combobox', name='notice-SU5LDSM')
    await stock_combobox.select_option('Out of Stock')
    # Click the Save button to apply the changes
    save_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Save')
    await save_button.click()
    # Wait for the page to update after saving
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
